name: Exp_ColorZerolagHLR
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagHLR oscillator, a zero-lag composite momentum indicator built from five weighted HLR (High-Low Range) components. It opens buy positions when the oscillator crosses upward and sell positions when it crosses downward, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Trading signals are processed only on new bars to avoid redundant entries.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagHLR振荡器进行交易，该振荡器是由五个加权HLR（高低范围）分量合成的零滞后动量指标。当振荡器向上交叉时开多仓，向下交叉时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。交易信号仅在新K线形成时处理以避免重复入场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于零滞后HLR振荡器，该指标通过五个不同周期（8、21、34、55、89）的HLR分量按不同权重（0.05、0.10、0.16、0.26、0.43）加权合成，旨在消除传统技术指标的滞后性。入场条件为：当振荡器主线在SignalBar位置从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越信号线时开空仓，即经典的振荡器交叉策略。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号触发平仓（多头平仓由BuyPosClose控制，空头平仓由SellPosClose控制），以及固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持手数模式和保证金比例模式，由MMMode参数决定。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中封装的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，信号仅在IsNewBar检测到新K线时生成，避免同一K线内重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Zero-Lag HLR oscillator, which combines five HLR components with different periods (8, 21, 34, 55, 89) and weights (0.05, 0.10, 0.16, 0.26, 0.43) to eliminate the lag inherent in traditional technical indicators. Entry conditions are classic oscillator crossover: a buy signal is generated when the main oscillator line crosses above the signal line at the specified SignalBar, and a sell signal is generated on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions include reverse crossover signals that trigger position closing (controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose flags), plus fixed stop-loss at 1000 points and take-profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either lot-based or margin-per-lot modes as determined by the MMMode parameter. Money management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen), which encapsulate order execution logic. Signals are only generated when IsNewBar detects a new bar formation, preventing redundant trades within the same bar.

pros: 使用零滞后振荡器设计，多周期加权合成减少了传统指标的滞后性问题
新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
提供完整的多空开关控制（开仓和平仓分别可独立启用/禁用），灵活性好
固定止损止盈设置，风险可量化
信号逻辑清晰，基于振荡器交叉，易于理解和回测
pros_en: Zero-lag oscillator design with multi-period weighted synthesis reduces the lag problem of traditional indicators
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Complete buy/sell toggle controls (open and close independently configurable) provide good flexibility
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings make risk quantifiable
Clear signal logic based on oscillator crossover is easy to understand and backtest
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动性（如ATR）动态调整，在不同市场条件下可能不适用
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能导致入场成本过高
振荡器交叉信号在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假信号，导致连续亏损
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易执行逻辑不透明
未设置最大持仓数量限制或最大回撤保护，缺乏整体风险控制框架
cons_en: Fixed 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit are not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility (e.g., ATR), potentially unsuitable across different market conditions
No spread filter, which may lead to excessive entry costs on high-spread instruments
Oscillator crossover signals tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Dependency on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library makes core trade execution logic opaque
No maximum position count limit or maximum drawdown protection, lacking an overall risk control framework
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
添加趋势过滤条件（如均线方向或更高时间周期趋势判断），减少震荡行情中的假信号
增加点差过滤和最大持仓/最大回撤保护机制，提升整体风控能力
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanism to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility
Add trend filter conditions (e.g., moving average direction or higher timeframe trend assessment) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Add spread filter and maximum position/drawdown protection mechanisms to enhance overall risk management

risk_points: 固定止损1000点在低波动品种上可能过大，在高波动品种上可能过小
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
震荡行情中交叉信号频繁触发可能导致连续止损
未限制最大同时持仓数量，极端情况下可能过度暴露
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop-loss may be too large for low-volatility instruments and too small for high-volatility ones
No spread filter may lead to unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
Frequent crossover signals in ranging markets may cause consecutive stop-loss hits
No limit on maximum simultaneous positions may lead to excessive exposure in extreme conditions
